hypothesis: The hot tier's cost is dominated by PCIe transfer
machine: RTX 4050 Laptop 6GB / 28GB RAM / PCIe gen4 x8
artifact: block 0, 18960-token real trace, 1000 tokens measured, mmap bank
result: at 16 slots: 4.646 ms/token total = 1.274 kernel + 0.223 GPU stall + 3.759 host staging; staging throughput 7.5 GB/s single-threaded
column9: 81% of the time is the CPU copying page-cached bytes into pinned staging, not PCIe. Measured directly by timing the copy, not inferred by subtraction

hypothesis: A pinned RAM bank removes the staging copy from the critical path

result: 16 slots 4.646 -> 2.879 ms/token (1.61x); 64 slots 3.377 -> 2.186 (1.55x); 256 slots 1.520 -> 1.330 (1.14x); host staging 0.000 ms throughout
column9: Accounting closes: 1.274 kernel + 1.407 measured stall vs 2.879 observed. 28.4 MB at the measured 12.76 GB/s would cost 2.22 ms, so ~37% of the transfer is hidden behind compute
